raw.title: Active Exploitation of Two Zero-Day Vulnerabilities in Ivanti Connect Secure VPN
raw.text: Volexity found active exploitation of two chained zero-days in Ivanti Connect Secure (formerly Pulse Connect Secure). CVE-2023-46805 is an authentication bypass and CVE-2024-21887 is a command injection, together giving unauthenticated remote code execution. Suspicious activity on the appliance goes back to 3 December 2023. The attacker wiped logs and disabled logging, backdoored the legitimate compcheckresult.cgi and modified a JavaScript file to capture credentials. Requests chain paths under /api/v1/totp/user-backup-code/ with traversal to reach system maintenance and license endpoints.
